name: chat-ui-bakeoff
description: Spike: assistant-ui vs CopilotKit React UI as the Locus chat/run surface over AG-UI (no @copilotkit/runtime).

scripts.build: npm run build -w variant-baseline && npm run build -w variant-assistant-ui && npm run build -w variant-copilotkit
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p variant-baseline && tsc -p variant-assistant-ui && tsc -p variant-copilotkit
scripts.licenses: node bench/licenses.mjs variant-assistant-ui && node bench/licenses.mjs variant-copilotkit
scripts.scan: node bench/scan-bundle.mjs variant-baseline && node bench/scan-bundle.mjs variant-assistant-ui && node bench/scan-bundle.mjs variant-copilotkit
